context: Personal, noncommercial workflow use; existing system cost/security/effect gates remain active.
source: Owner-provided live browser repo tabs; 21 repository tabs collapsed to 20 unique upstream URLs.

items.role: fast structured public-web acquisition, DOM and optional layout
items.test_gate: Compare DOM/Markdown/JSON extraction and browser interoperability against Playwright Chromium on a three-site synthetic crawl.

items.role: adaptive multi-step browser agent with local models or optional cloud browser
items.test_gate: Run adaptive form, navigation, download and recovery fixture versus direct Playwright and Skyvern.

items.role: MCP control of an existing logged-in Chrome session
items.test_gate: Use browser_list_tabs and upload/click/read on a controlled Chrome profile; verify host focus and session isolation.

items.role: local Gradio interface for inspecting and testing browser agents
items.test_gate: Evaluate assisted agent debugging and session replay in the isolated LAB against the existing Office visibility surface.

items.role: long-running remotely reachable browser agent on a personal host
items.test_gate: Compare restart/resume, operator takeover and browser state retention against existing Grokbot/Office long-job fixtures.

items.role: interactive page-local research and assisted browser actions
items.test_gate: Evaluate selective page read, guarded form interaction and malicious-page negative controls in a disposable Chrome profile.

items.role: optional hosted browser session and element-based automation
items.test_gate: Compare a synthetic remote-browser crawl against local Browserless on reproducibility, session teardown and per-task cost.

items.role: sample Playwright-to-Scrapeless CDP integration
items.test_gate: Retain as integration reference only; reopen if Scrapeless becomes an admitted remote-browser provider.

items.role: low-resource agent browser, native MCP and replayable PandaScript
items.test_gate: Compare web-platform functionality, native MCP session isolation, capture-to-replay and memory/time against Chromium.

items.role: isolated persistent browser identities and visible CDP sessions
items.test_gate: Compare cold-start, profile separation, restore and manual takeover against ordinary isolated Playwright profiles.

items.role: Rust/V8 headless engine with local CDP and extraction
items.test_gate: Run the same structured extraction/CDP/render smoke as Moli and Lightpanda; measure throughput and crashes.

items.role: repeatable crawling with queues, retries and structured extraction
items.test_gate: Run the public vendor-product/documentation fixture with duplicate control, retries, freshness and bounded parallelism.

items.role: AI-assisted and scripted form/process automation with local UI
items.test_gate: Compare multi-step synthetic forms, files, interrupted workflow recovery and validator accuracy against Browser Use.

items.role: optional compatibility proxy for specifically authorized web sources
items.test_gate: Keep as a bounded compatibility reference after a documented, permitted target failure; no general-purpose default route.

items.role: managed local browser sessions, concurrency queues and remote CDP
items.test_gate: Compare isolated Docker browser pool to current Playwright contexts and Selenium Grid on queues, crash recovery and multi-session state.

items.role: agent-friendly browser REST API with accessibility snapshots and session isolation
items.test_gate: Compare accessibility refs, file upload/download, snapshot cost, recoverability and REST integration against Browser Harness.

items.role: TypeScript autonomous browser agent with replay and resource isolation
items.test_gate: Run the same browser-agent action and crash/resume fixture against Browser Use and Skyvern.

items.role: plugin-based Puppeteer/Playwright compatibility research
items.test_gate: Check version-pinned compatibility with current Node/Playwright and any legitimately required existing plugin.

items.role: Python driverless CDP control of Chrome and Edge with typed extraction
items.test_gate: Compare Edge CDP tabs, reading, form, download and retained session with Playwright on synthetic authenticated fixture.

items.role: historical headless Chrome dynamic-rendering reference
items.test_gate: No runtime benchmark. Revisit only if an exact historical rendering regression requires source archaeology.
